conflictsOfInterest: The reviewer is the project founder and owner. The review records that role explicitly; it is an internal owner decision, not independent external validation.
method: Guided interactive review on 2026-11-11 in four blocks (host extraction and subscription route; verifiable reward; runner, hooks, stops and pipeline; real baseline and closure), each presented with its evidence and limits.

humanReview.rationale: Approve BL.1 within its documented scope: subscription-only runner with paid-route refusal, credential kept in the environment, verifiable replayable reward with no model judge, hooks and manual-resume stops, fake-host pipeline with negative controls, and one real Claude Code baseline (16/30, inside the T010 interval, zero paid-route observations) labelled route-changed comparison. Limits stated in each evidence record apply; Claude Code reported apiKeySource none; OpenCode is a declared limit (OD-2).

milestoneClosure.milestone: BL.1 — Lightning rollouts and verifiable reward (#30)
milestoneClosure.rationale: Close BL.1. This does not approve BL.2-BL.5, any optimization run or result, promotion, or execution authority.
